name: The Reef Hermit
classification: Hushed Far Side boss; new boss kind

palette.palette_note: Only specified_hex is numerically fixed by the project text; other swatches describe this generated design and are approximate.

locks: The shell is an old sunken stone shrine: cracked dome, carved pillars, coral and barnacles.
A single bronze bell hangs from an interior beam in the shrine doorway, with a clapper.
Two huge armoured claws; anatomical RIGHT is conspicuously larger than LEFT.
Front view: RIGHT claw is on picture-left. Right-side profile faces picture-right, larger claw on the near side.
Six thin articulated armoured walking legs, three per side, as established by this front master.
Two separate eye-stalks with dull violet eyes; no emissive eye glow.
A small black-violet Hush crack crosses the crab carapace and leaks violet ash; ordinary stone cracks remain separate.
Soft pale pink-grey curled abdomen stays hidden in the shrine for the front/turnaround.
out_of_shell.png exposes the intact unarmoured curled abdomen halfway through the doorway as the crab reaches forward.
Whole creature including shrine is 4 m tall; the shrine bottom is about a standing person's height above the foot plane, without a drawn scale figure.

turnaround_layout: 2x2: front and front three-quarter on top; anatomical right profile facing right and back on bottom. Same scale and one baseline per row; wide natural body preserved.
